༄༅/ /lag pa'i mchod pa rgyas pa dang phyi rol mchod pa bsdus pa tshogs gnyis kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lag pa'i mchod pa rgyas pa dang phyi rol mchod pa bsdus pa tshogs gnyis kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru mañdzu nā thā ya/ lag pa'i mchod pa rgyas pa dang phyi rol gyi mchod pa mdor bsdus tshogs gnyis kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor lhur byed pa'i sgrub pos kha zas kyi dus sam/ tshogs 'khor rgyas pa'i tshe'am/ de las gzhan du tshes bcu'i mchod pa sogs kyi tshe mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba ma 'dzom pa'am/ long skabs ma byung ba sogs kyi dus/ lag mchod rgyas par bya bar spro na/ me tog la sogs pa'i phyi mchod dang*/ sha chang sogs gong bu dang khu ba'i rdzas ci 'byor ba kha na ma tho ba med pa rnams mdun du bzhag /rang sgrub thabs ltar bdag gi rnal 'byor rgyas pa'am ma grub na/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ zhes pas bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur par bsam/ rdzas rnams sgrub thabs kyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod nas blangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas lag pa g.yon par gtor zhing mnye/ sor mo lnga la bdud rtsi'i thig le'am me tog gi tshom bu re re dang*/ lag mthil du thig le'am tshom bu dbus dang mthar lnga bkod la/ mthe bong la oṃ ha dkar po las rdo rje dkar po/ mdzub mo la na ma hi ser po las 'khor lo ser po/ gung mo la swā hā hu dmar po las pad+ma dmar po/ srin lag la bau ṣaṭa he nag po las rdo rje nag po/ mthe'u chung la huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser las rin po che dmar ser/ sen mo rnams la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu las ral gri ljang gu/ phyag mtshan de rnams rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mthe bong la rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dkar po/ zhal lhag ma g.yas nag

/g.yon dmar/ phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje/ ḍā ru/ mgo bo/ g.yon gsum dril bu/ thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa la/ rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar po/ zhal g.yas sngo/ g.yon ljang*/ phyag g.yas gsum gri gug /tshangs mgo/ lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ zhags pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ mdzum mo la rnam snang ser po/ g.yas dang pos 'khor lo 'dzin pa la yum gshin rje ma sngon mo/ gung mo la pad+ma gar dbang dmar po/ g.yas dang po pad+ma/ yum rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ srin lag la dpal he ru ka nag po g.yas dang po rdo rje/ yum skyod byed ma ser mo/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ g.yas dang po rin po che/ yum skrag byed ma ljang gu/ sen mo lnga la rta mchog ljang gu/ g.yas dang po ral gri/ yum gtum mo dud kha/ yab rnams g.yas gnyis pa ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dang po dril bu/ gnyis pas thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gshin rje ma la sogs pa lnga zhal gcig /phyag bzhi/ g.yas dang pos gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon dang pos thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pa ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rdor sems zla ba dang gzhan rnams nyi ma la gnas pa/ lag mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po| mdun nas g.yon skor du haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ hrīṃ moṃ dkar po/ hriṃ hrīṃ ser po/ huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams las gri gug rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros| don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su phag mo dmar mo/ mdun nas g.yon skor du gshin rje ma sngon mo| rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ skyod byed ma ser mo/ skrag byed ma ljang mo/ gtum mo dud kha/ yab rnams g.yas gnyis pa ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dang po dril bu/ gnyis pas thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis yum la 'khyud pa/

gshin rje ma la sogs pa lnga zhal gcig /phyag bzhi/ g.yas dang pos gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon dang pos thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pa ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rmongs byed ma zla ba/ gzhan rnams nyi ma la g.yas brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis bsgyings pa| rdor sems dang phag mo phyag rgya drug dang gzhan rnams phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa thod skam gyi dbu rgyan can/ dpa' bo rnams mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang stag gi smad g.yogs can/ mi mgo'i do shal 'phyang ba/ yum rnams gcer bu skra grol ba/ lag pa'i bol la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra= las bcom ldan 'das/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro= las rnal 'byor ma/ oṃ ḍā ki= las mkha' 'gro ma/ oṃ lā me= las rab mdzes ma/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa= las dum skyes ma/ oṃ rū pi= las gzugs can ma rnams so so'i sku mdog rgyan cha lugs yongs rdzogs shel gyi gzugs brnyan lta bu gsal la rdzogs pa/ lag pa'i sa'i khams ni ltung byed ma ser mo/ g.yas dang pos 'khor lo/ chu'i khams ni gsod byed ma nag mo/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje/ me'i khams ni 'gugs byed ma dmar mo/ g.yas dang pos pad+ma/ rlung gi khams ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sngo sangs/ g.yas dang pos ral gri/ bzhi ga zhal gcig /phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pas gri gug /g.yon dang pos thod pa/ gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma dra ba can ma sku dang rtsa zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis gri gug /tshangs mgo/ lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāk+s+yaṃ/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ de lnga ga gcer mo skra grol g.yas brkyang gis rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ dpa' bo thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/

yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ dpa' mo rnams kyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba'i gdan la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba la pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma la rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur par mos/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad dang dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa'i tshogs la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum pa bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams de rnams la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas thog mar g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod thigs gtor 'bul zhing*/ oṃ ha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes de bzhin du/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭa haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces so so'i mthar yi ge gsum btags pas sor mo'i lha rnams dang*/ slar/ oṃ baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ haṃ yoṃ= hrīṃ moṃ= hriṃ hrīṃ= huṃ hūm̐= phaṭa phaṭa= rnams la 'bru gsum sbyar bas lag mthil gyi lha rnams dang*/

yab yum gyi snying po gnyis dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags rnams la yi ge gsum btags pas bol gyi lha rnams dang*/ lāṃ= māṃ= pāṃ= tāṃ= khāṃ= rnams re re la 'bru gsum btags pas khams lnga'i lha mo rnams mchod/ de nas khu ba'i rdzas ja thug 'o ma zho sogs dang*/ gong bu'i rdzas sha zan 'khur ba sogs gang yod rnams kyang gong ltar rang rang gi sngags kyis so sor dbul/ de rjes nyer spyod lnga dang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis sogs bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod/ he ru ka'i yig brgya bzlas pas chad lhag kha bskang*/ lag pa'i lha la phul ba'i rdzas rnams kyi phyed snod gzhan du bzhag ste sba/ longs spyod 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs/ phyed tshogs rdzas rnams sam/ rang nyid za ba'i kha zas la bsre/ lag pa la 'gos pa'i rdzas rnams g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes brjod cing rang gi snying ga dang lce dang mgo la byugs pas/ lag pa la gnas pa'i lha tshogs rnams bdag nyid la thim par gyur par mos/ lag pa la 'gos pa'i rdzas lhag ma rnams lag pa phan tshun mnyes la rang gi gdong dang yan lag la byugs na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// ha cang rgyas pa la mi spro na sngar gyi go bgo ba nas rgyas gdab pa'i bar ma byas kyang chad pa'i nyes pa med do/// / ༈ yang phyi rol gyi mchod pa rgyas pa ni dkyil 'khor mdun bskyed dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar yin la/ phyi rol mchod pa bsdus pa ni lag mchod dang 'brel ba yin te/ bya bar 'dod na mdun du legs par sbyangs pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'du byas la/ thog mar lag mchod gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar byas nas/ lag pa'i lha ma gshegs gong du/ lag g.yon pa'i srin lag gis maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su reg la lha rnams kyi sngags brjod pas dag pa'i zhing gi rang bzhin du mos/ slar byin brlabs byas pa'i nang mchod kyis maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du chos 'byung bsnol ba bri/

de'i dbus su dkyil 'khor zlum po bris la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gi spyan drangs te mngon sum du maṇ+ḍal steng du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas thog mar thod par gnas pa'i nang mchod g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon du bskor bas blangs te gyen du gtor zhing rtsa ba'i bla ma la 'bul/ de rjes brgyud pa'i bla ma'i mtshan la yi ge gsum btags la 'bul ba sgrub thabs kyi nang gi mchod pa'i skabs ltar bya/ de rjes yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying*/ mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi'i sngags la 'bru gsum btags la dkyil 'khor pa la 'bul/ de rjes dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong*/ zhing skyong*/ lha/ klu/ 'byung po rnams la 'bul/ de nas spyi dang sgos kyi chos skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag dang*/ sems can thams cad kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhar bsams la 'bul/ de nas byin brlabs byas pa'i khu ba bza' bca' gong bu'i rdzas gang yod rnams rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags sam gong ltar sngags kyis so sor dbul/ de nas nyer spyod lnga rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ he ru ka'i yig brgyas lhag chad bskang*/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes rnam lnga 'dod kor dang 'khyud stangs byas la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod de srin lag g.yon pas maṇ+ḍal la reg pas dkyil 'khor pa rnams bdag nyid la bstim/ maṇ+ḍal la gos pa'i chang g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te rang gi snying ga dang lce dang mgo bor byug /hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes brjod pas lag par gnas pa'i lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par bsam/ smon lam dang shis brjod bya'o// gang gis 'bad rtsol ches che bas// bsgrubs kyang 'grub pa'i nges pa ci// ci ste zab mo'i gnad ldan na// 'bad pa chung ngus grol bar nges// lag pa'i mchod pa rgyas pa dang phyi rol gyi mchod pa bsdus ba bya ba'i tshul tshogs gnyis kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba 'di'ang*/

kun mkhyen bu la sogs pa mkhas grub gong ma'i phyag len ji lta bar 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung las dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ shing bya rus sbal zla ba'i dkar po'i rgyal ba gsum par sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa dag go// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
